💡 drift | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: Enhancing the aesthetic appeal of a terminal during periods of user inactivity by displaying dynamic, artistic animations.
✨ Key Features: • 14 unique animated scenes (e.g., waveform, constellation, rain, particles, life, clock) • 9 built-in themes matched to popular terminal colorschemes • Automatic activation on idle and resumption on key press • Cross-platform compatibility (macOS, Linux, Windows) • Customizable scenes and themes
📖 Summary: Drift is a terminal screensaver written in Go that transforms idle time into ambient visual art. It offers a variety of animated scenes and themes, activating automatically when the terminal is inactive and resuming upon user input.
